definitions.explanation: Relating to or involving two or more countries.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{会議|かいぎ}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I participated in an international conference.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{関係|かんけい}を{学|まな}んでいます。
{国際|こくさい}{空港|くうこう}まで{車|くるま}で{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the international airport by car.

notes:
{国際|こくさい} means 'international,' combining {国|くに} (country) + {際|さい} (between/occasion).

USAGE:
Primarily used as a prefix in compound words rather than standalone.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {国際的|こくさいてき}: international (na-adjective)
- {国際線|こくさいせん}: international flight/route
- {国際空港|こくさいくうこう}: international airport
- {国際関係|こくさいかんけい}: international relations
- {国際社会|こくさいしゃかい}: international community
- {国際連合|こくさいれんごう}: United Nations (UN)
- {国際化|こくさいか}: internationalization

CONTRAST:
- {国内|こくない}: domestic (within the country)
- {国際線|こくさいせん} vs {国内線|こくないせん}: international vs domestic flights
